title: A Teen's Roblox Game Beat Fortnite's Player Record

scenes.text: A teen's game beat Fortnite's record.
Grow a Garden is a Roblox game where you plant, harvest and sell crops.
In June 2025, 21.6 million people played it at the same moment.
Its creator was sixteen, and built it in just a few days.
A game about watering plants beat the biggest battle royale on Earth.

description:
A teen's game beat Fortnite's record.
In late June 2025, Roblox's Grow a Garden hit 21.6 million players at once, beating the previous record of 15.2 million set by Fortnite.
Would you have bet on a gardening game? Comment below.
first_comment: Gardening game or battle royale: which would you rather play?
